_note: Real user reviews, added by hand as they arrive from testers and members. Add one object per review to the 'reviews' array: { "name": "first name only", "when": "e.g. Day 30", "text": "their own words", "stars": 5 }. Leave the array empty until a real person has actually said it - never invent quotes, names or star counts. The /reviews page and its structured data read from this file.
